commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Address PR feedback for web search implementation

- Refactor WebSearchServiceFactory to create HttpClient internally, removing
  IHttpClientFactory dependency to match other factory patterns in codebase
- Add ownsHttpClient parameter to TavilySearchService for proper disposal
- Implement proper Dispose pattern with dispose tracking
- Consolidate exception handling in SearchWebAsync using HandleToolException
- Document APP_UID change in Dockerfile (1001 for dedicated non-root UID)
- Remove unused System.Net.Http using directive
- Update SonarAnalyzer.CSharp to 10.18.0.131500

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Fix Docker build: make appsettings.Development.json optional

The Development config file is in .gitignore and not available in CI/CD.
Made the Content include conditional in the csproj so builds succeed
when the file doesn't exist (production/CI environments).

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Fix Docker build: add missing appsettings.json files to build context

The build was failing because appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json
were not being copied into the Docker build context. The Console project
references these files via relative paths (../../appsettings.json), but only
src/, tests/, Directory.Build.props, and stylecop.json were being copied.

This fixes the MSB3030 error: Could not copy the file '/src/appsettings.json'
because it was not found.

Add Azure DevOps skill documentation and remove outdated agent file

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Add PowerShell support to Docker container and implement PowerShellExecutor

- Created `POWERSHELL-CONTAINER-SUMMARY.md` for documentation on changes made to the Dockerfile for PowerShell Core installation.
- Added `test-docker-powershell.ps1` script for testing PowerShell functionality in the Docker container.
- Implemented `IPowerShellExecutor` interface for executing PowerShell scripts.
- Developed `PowerShellExecutor` class with execution logic, timeout handling, and output management.
- Introduced `PowerShellOptions` and `PowerShellResult` classes for configuration and result handling.
- Added unit tests for `PowerShellExecutor` to ensure functionality and error handling.
- Created `TEST-PROMPTS.md` for integration test prompts to validate PowerShell execution.
